# Pricing

Acme is sold on three plans. Every plan includes unlimited connections and the full catalogue of integrations.

## Starter

For small teams getting started. Daily syncs, email support, and up to five connections.

## Business

For growing teams. Hourly syncs, priority support, and SAML single sign-on is included on the Business and Enterprise plans.

## Enterprise

For organisations with procurement, security and compliance requirements. Custom sync schedules, a named support contact, a 99.9% uptime commitment, and volume pricing.

Contact sales for an Enterprise quote.
